recent_excerpts: Google's September Pixel bulletin patches CVE-2026-58704, a high-severity modem privilege-escalation flaw under limited, targeted exploitation, plus 109 other bugs.
CISA added CVE-2026-42016, a JFrog Artifactory token-scope authorization flaw enabling privilege escalation, to its KEV catalog with a Sept 25 patch deadline.
CVE-2026-81963 and CVE-2026-85880 are Windows EoP zero-days exploited before patch. Microsoft's Sept 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes a record 964 CVEs—patch now.
